name: Styracosaurus
group: Animals > Dinosaurs > Land grazers > Horned and frilled dinosaurs

features.claim: It was a fairly large dinosaur, about 5 to 5.5 metres long.
features.quote: Styracosaurus was a relatively large dinosaur, reaching lengths of 5–5.5 metres (16–18 ft) and weighing about 1.8–2.7 metric tons (2.0–3.0 short tons).
It stood about 1.8 meters (5.9 feet) tall.

features.claim: It had four short legs and a bulky body.
features.quote: Styracosaurus possessed four short legs and a bulky body.

features.claim: It had a single horn sticking out of its nose.
features.quote: a single horn protruding from its nose, which may have been up to 60 centimeters (2 feet) long and 15 centimeters (6 inches) wide

features.claim: It had four to six long spikes sticking out from the frill around its neck.
features.quote: It had four to six long parietal spikes extending from its neck frill

features.claim: It had a smaller horn on each of its cheeks.
features.quote: a smaller jugal horn on each of its cheeks

features.claim: Its skull had a beak at the front of the mouth.
features.quote: The skull had a beak and shearing cheek teeth arranged in continuous dental batteries, suggesting that the animal sliced up plants.

features.claim: Its body was bulky, like a rhinoceros.
features.quote: The bulky body of Styracosaurus resembled that of a rhinoceros.
It had powerful shoulders which may have been useful in intraspecies combat.

features.claim: Each toe had a hooflike claw covered in horn.
features.quote: Each toe bore a hooflike ungual which was sheathed in horn.

features.claim: The skull was massive, with a large nostril and a tall straight nose horn.
features.quote: The skull was massive, with a large nostril, a tall straight nose horn, and a parietal squamosal frill (a neck frill) crowned with at least four large spikes.

debated.claim: The exact length of the nose horn is uncertain, because its tip was not preserved.
debated.quote: The nasal horn was estimated by Lambe at 57 centimeters (22 inches) long in the type specimen, but the tip had not been preserved.

debated.claim: The small horns and knobs on the frill's edge varied from one individual to another.
debated.quote: Aside from the large nasal horn and four long frill spikes, the cranial ornamentation was variable.

debated.claim: How its legs were held has been proposed in different ways.
debated.quote: Various limb positions have been proposed for Styracosaurus and ceratopsids in general, including forelegs which were held underneath the body, or, alternatively, held in a sprawling position.

second_reading.claim: What the horns and frill were for has been argued about for many years.
second_reading.quote: The function or functions of the horns and frills have been debated for many years.
second_reading.why: a picture could not show it
